title: Anker Nano USB-C Hub (8-in-1, Dual Display)
description: Versatile 8-in-1 Connectivity: Includes a USB-C upstream plug with 85W max output and 10 Gbps data transfer, a 100W max USB-C PD input port, a 10 Gbps USB-C data port, two 10 Gbps USB-A data ports, two HDMI ports supporting up to 4K@60 Hz, and SD / TF 3.0 card slots with transfer speeds up to 104 MB/s. Dual Displays for Windows: Expand your workspace with crisp 4K@60 Hz visuals on up to two external monitors, ideal for multitasking, editing, and more. Compatibility: Supports full-function USB-C, USB4, and Thunderbolt connections. Compatible with Windows 10 / 11, ChromeOS, and laptops that support DP Alt Mode and Power Delivery. (Note: On macOS, both external monitors will display identical content. This device is not compatible with Linux.) What You Get: Anker Nano USB-C Hub (8-in-1, Dual Display), welcome guide, hassle-free warranty, and our friendly customer service.

title: Anker 10-in-1 Desktop USB-C Hub (Dual 4K, Smart Display)
description: All-in-One Connectivity: The 10-in-1 design features one HDMI 2.1 port, one DisplayPort 1.4 port, one 100W max PD-IN port for up to 80W host charging, one 10 Gbps USB-C port, one 10 Gbps USB-A data port, two 5 Gbps USB-A ports, one Gigabit Ethernet port, and SD / microSD 3.0 card slots. (Note: Charger not included. For optimal performance, use a 65W or higher USB-C charger.) Dual Display Support with Up to 2K@240 Hz: Drive a single monitor at up to 4K@144 Hz or 2K@240 Hz, or expand to dual 2K@240 Hz displays for ultra-smooth motion in gaming, editing, and streaming. (Note: Dual 2K@240 Hz output requires a host laptop USB-C port that supports DP 2.1 with DSC 3:1. Video output is supported through HDMI and DisplayPort only.) Smart Built-In Display: The built-in display shows real-time port status, charging power, data transfer speed, and device temperature. Upload your own images for a rotating slideshow, or press twice to start the customizable focus timer. Declutter Your Desk Setup: With 80% of ports facing the rear, cables route backward and downward to reduce the clutter common with flat hub designs. A 27.6-inch built-in host cable allows flexible placement while keeping the front of your desk clear. Web and App Control: Customize your smart display, track port status, and adjust the 25-minute focus timer settings on the web dashboard, or run photo album slideshows and firmware updates through the app. Compatibility: Works with laptops whose USB-C ports support Power Delivery, DisplayPort 1.2 / 1.4 / 2.1, and either USB4 or Thunderbolt 3 / 4 / 5. Supports Windows 10 / 11 and macOS. (Note: On macOS, both external monitors will display identical content. This device is not compatible with Linux.) What's in the Box: Anker Desktop USB-C Hub, magnetic base, safety sheet with QR code for the user manual, hassle-free warranty, and our friendly customer service.

title: Anker x VALORANT 100W GaN Charger (Battery Care & Smart Display)
description: Authentic VALORANT-Inspired Design: Featuring 8 iconic Agents in intricate, dimensional UV-printed designs across both sides. The port side features a classic VALORANT grid pattern with an iridescent electroplated finish for added visual depth and texture. Pick Your Agent, Set Your Theme: Choose your favorite from 8 iconic Agents and personalize your charger with exclusive VALORANT-themed UI. Jett is available at launch, with Phoenix and Killjoy coming via an OTA update in October, followed by more Agent themes in future updates. (Note: Use the Anker Charging Manager desktop app to switch between Agent UI themes.) Extend Your Laptop Battery Lifespan by Up to 40%*: Once connected, the charger recognizes your laptop model and offers two charging modes: Auto Mode for fast charging and Care Mode, which applies a laptop-specific charging curve for long-term battery care. (Note: The up-to-40% battery lifespan extension is based on internal bare-cell lab testing. Actual laptop battery lifespan extension may vary significantly depending on device configuration and usage.) 100W Max Fast Charging with Sustained Full-Power Output: Delivers up to 100W with sustained full-power output under supported conditions. Charge a 14" MacBook Pro (M5, 2025) from 0% to 50% in just 30 minutes. (Note: Sustained 100W output was tested at an ambient temperature of 77°F (25°C). Actual performance may vary.) Real-Time Charging Insights on a Smart Display: The built-in display shows charging power, charger temperature, and charging progress at a glance, with playful animations that make every charge more engaging. Free Software Updates and Custom Wallpapers: Install the Anker Charging Manager app to access updates that expand laptop support and personalize the display with custom wallpapers. Compact Size with Foldable Plug: 38% smaller and 33% lighter than the original 96W charger, with a 90° foldable plug for easier packing. It slips easily into your bag for travel. What You Get: Anker Laptop Charger Pro, Anker Zolo USB-C to USB-C Cable (5 ft, 240W, Braided), welcome guide, 18-month warranty, and our friendly customer service.

description: All-in-One Connectivity: The 10-in-1 design features one HDMI 2.1 port, one DisplayPort 1.4 port, one 100W max PD-IN port for up to 80W host charging, one 10 Gbps USB-C port, one 10 Gbps USB-A data port, two 5 Gbps USB-A ports, one Gigabit Ethernet port, and SD / microSD 3.0 card slots. (Note: Dual 2K@240 Hz output requires a host laptop USB-C port that supports DP 2.1 with DSC 3:1. Video output is supported through HDMI and DisplayPort only.) Upload your own images for a rotating slideshow, or press twice to start the customizable focus timer. Declutter Your Desk Setup: With 80% of ports facing the rear, cables route backward and downward to reduce the clutter common with flat hub designs. A 27.6-inch built-in host cable allows flexible placement while keeping the front of your desk clear. Web and App Control: Customize your smart display, track port status, and adjust the 25-minute focus timer settings on the web dashboard, or run photo album slideshows and firmware updates through the app. Compatibility: Works with laptops whose USB-C ports support Power Delivery, DisplayPort 1.2 / 1.4 / 2.1, and either USB4 or Thunderbolt 3 / 4 / 5. Supports Windows 10 / 11 and macOS. (Note: On macOS, both external monitors will display identical content. This device is not compatible with Linux.)
